blocks.text: Aftershock is a 1990 action/science fiction film directed by Frank Harris, written by Michael Standing, starring James Lew and Michael Standing. It was distributed through Overseas Filmgroup and filmed in 1988.

Quake, also known as Aftershock (USA) and The Stalker, is a United States suspense thriller direct-to-video film directed by Louis Morneau and released on June 23, 1992. The film stars Steve Railsback and Erika Anderson.
